summary.text: Alan Bond is an independent candidate running on the Hope for Tomorrow Party line for New Jersey's 11th Congressional District. He holds degrees from Dartmouth College and Harvard Business School and has worked in business strategy. He ran in the April 2026 special election for this seat and received 0.5% of the vote. In a statement published by the New Jersey Globe, he said he is running because many residents feel the two-party system does not fully represent them, and listed affordability, infrastructure, and protecting Social Security as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Alan Bond earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College and a graduate degree from Harvard Business School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in business strategy.

He ran as an independent in the April 16, 2026 special election for NJ-11 and received 625 votes, or 0.5%. He was not invited to an April 1, 2026 debate between Mejia and Hathaway, and the New Jersey Globe published his written response.
He is on the November 3, 2026 ballot on the Hope for Tomorrow Party line.
